note: FNS 1036.2 is a one-line QC cross-reference: 'Negative Allegation. See data matching requirements, Section 512.' Section 512 prescribes QC reviewer procedures for running data matches (IEVS, SAVE, eDRS) during quality control reviews — it is QC methodology, not caseworker policy. The underlying operational requirement — that the agency use data matching systems to verify eligibility — IS covered in the OLG through extensive guidance on external databases (BENDEX, SDX, SVES, Work Number, DOR) at application and recertification, interview procedures instructing workers to 'check available external databases,' and the Unclear Information / Significantly Conflicting Information framework for investigating discrepancies. The OLG does not use the term 'negative allegation,' but this is a QC-specific concept describing what a reviewer must do when a household denies a circumstance, not a caseworker-facing policy rule.
